{"sample_id":"5762063012462592","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":648,"var":"oid","code":"result = asn1_read_value(c2, root2, oid, &len);","role":"source","note":"The PKCS#12 input controls the contentType OID read from the authenticated safe and determines whether the parser treats the content as plain SafeContents."},{"step":2,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":646,"var":"strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) == 0","code":"if (strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) == 0) {","role":"intermediate","note":"This branch forwards the input-controlled content type into the SafeContents parser for unencrypted data."},{"step":3,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_parse_safe_contents","line":571,"var":"content","code":"result = _gnutls_x509_read_string(sc, sc_name, &content, ASN1_ETYPE_OCTET_STRING, 1);","role":"intermediate","note":"The OCTET STRING payload is extracted from the selected safe contents and passed to the decoder."},{"step":4,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":409,"var":"bag->bag_elements","code":"bag->bag_elements = MIN(MAX_BAG_ELEMENTS, count);","role":"root_cause","note":"The parser records the number of bags from the ASN.1 element count, but later code assumes the decoded bag entries are fully initialized even when the input structure is malformed or partially decoded."},{"step":5,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":439,"var":"bag->element[i].data","code":"result = _gnutls_x509_read_value(c2, root, &bag->element[i].data);","role":"sink","note":"Each bag value is read into the bag array; malformed input can leave later consumers observing uninitialized bag fields derived from this decode path."}],"vuln_logic":{"source":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":648,"operands":["oid"]},"root_cause":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":409,"operands":["bag->bag_elements","count"],"relation":{"op":"le","left":"bag->bag_elements","right":"MAX_BAG_ELEMENTS"}},"sink":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":439,"operands":["bag->element[i].data","root"],"relation":{"op":"eq","left":"bag->element[i].data","right":"root"}},"propagation":[{"from":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":648,"operands":["oid"]},"to":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_parse_safe_contents","line":571,"operands":["content"]},"type":"control","via":["strcmp(oid, DATA_OID) == 0"],"relation":{"op":"eq","left":"oid","right":"DATA_OID"}},{"from":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_parse_safe_contents","line":571,"operands":["content"]},"to":{"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":439,"operands":["bag->element[i].data"]},"type":"data","via":["_gnutls_x509_read_string","_gnutls_x509_read_value"],"relation":{"op":"eq","left":"content","right":"bag->element[i].data"}}]}}
JSON
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc1.p12 /workspace/analysis.json` executed with exit code 2.
